_about: James Boswell. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: Journals. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling; each row is US public domain (title page, Gutenberg header or IA metadata read, recorded in _bloom).

boswell-private-papers-malahide-castle: Private Papers of James Boswell from Malahide Castle, in the collection of Lt-Colonel Ralph Heyward Isham (vol. I: 1754-1763)

boswell-private-papers-malahide-castle.year: 1928 (title page: 'Copyright, 1928, Ralph H. Isham ... Printed in the United States of America')
boswell-private-papers-malahide-castle.evidence: Read title page, note and contents: 'Journal of my Jaunt, Harvest 1762', 'First memoranda of Johnson 1763'; collection internetarchivebooks, djvu downloads.
boswell-private-papers-malahide-castle.case: Bloom's 'Journals' are the private journals, first printed in Isham's limited Private Papers (1928-34); the 1928-1930 volumes are US-PD and vol. I is on IA. The Hebrides journal (1785) is the published journal.
boswell-private-papers-malahide-castle.note: Only vol. I of Isham was found readable; later vols are lending-only or post-1930 (a 1931 vol. is lending). The Yale trade editions (1950-) are not PD. Notable find.
